audit_items.proof_trace: Normal liquidation correctly enforces `weighted_debts_value > collateral_weighted_value` at L978-981. The ADL paths (handle_debt_auto_deleverage, handle_collateral_auto_deleverage) intentionally use a different condition (`user_ltv > liquidation_ltv` where user_ltv = weighted_debts/collateral_total) because ADL is a systemic-risk mechanism, not a per-position insolvency check — further protected by separate permissions (whitelist_admin::adl()), system-level limit-breach guards, and timelocks.
